statement: SDL HIDAPI, at the pinned revision, opens Joy-Con halves (2006, 2007, and 200e grip interfaces) directly and, unless the combine hint is disabled (default true), automatically joins the first unparented left and right into a virtual 'Switch Joy-Con (L/R)' device with PID 0x2008 without any user gesture. The combined device reports the right half's IMU as its primary sensor and also exposes per-half sensors.
